title: Predicates on extracted equations
statement: Let $\nu$ be a finite set, choose a variable $v\in\nu$, and let a list of linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$ yield a pivot equation $E$ and a remaining list under pivot extraction at $v$. For any predicate $P$ on such equations, every equation in the original list satisfies $P$ if and only if $E$ satisfies $P$ and every equation in the remaining list satisfies $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $\nu$ is a finite type with decidable equality
$P$ is a predicate on linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$
The input list yields pivot equation $E$ and a remaining list under extraction
